regions.name: Patagonia

state_distinguishers.Tierra_del_Fuego: Southernmost roads in world, very distinctive end-of-world feel, Ushuaia city infrastructure
state_distinguishers.Santa_Cruz: Perito Moreno glacier area, El Calafate tourist infrastructure
state_distinguishers.Neuquen: More developed, Bariloche tourist area, ski resort infrastructure

regions.route_sign_clues: RN-40 (Ruta Nacional 40) runs length of Patagonia. Very distinctive blue and white Argentine signs.
regions.gemini_hint: End of world feel + beech forests = Tierra del Fuego. Glacier tourism signs = Santa Cruz. Ski resort infrastructure = Neuquen/Bariloche. RN-40 signs = Patagonia confirmed.
common_false_positives: Flat steppe — shared across eastern Patagonia
Andean peaks — shared with Chile border area

regions.name: Pampas and Buenos Aires

state_distinguishers.Buenos_Aires_City: Massive urban area, specific CABA infrastructure, very European city feel
state_distinguishers.Cordoba: Sierras de Cordoba hills, Cordoba city second largest in Argentina
state_distinguishers.Entre_Rios: More rivers and streams, subtropical feel, Mesopotamia region

regions.route_sign_clues: RN-9 through Cordoba. RN-14 through Entre Rios. Autopistas near Buenos Aires.
regions.gemini_hint: Completely flat soybean fields = pampas provinces. European-style urban = Buenos Aires. Rolling hills = Cordoba sierras. Rivers and subtropical = Entre Rios.
common_false_positives: Agricultural fields — shared across pampas provinces

regions.name: Northwest Argentina

state_distinguishers.Jujuy: Quebrada de Humahuaca — dramatic colorful rock gorge, very distinctive UNESCO landscape
state_distinguishers.Salta: Colonial architecture in city, cloud forest in east, salt flats in west
state_distinguishers.Tucuman: More subtropical and green, sugarcane fields, smallest but most densely populated

regions.route_sign_clues: RN-9 runs through northwest. RN-40 along Andes.
regions.gemini_hint: Colorful layered rock gorge = Quebrada de Humahuaca = Jujuy. Sugarcane fields = Tucuman. Salt flats = Salta/Jujuy puna. Colonial architecture = Salta city.
common_false_positives: Andean terrain — shared with Chile and Bolivia
